statements.quote: We achieved a healthy revenue growth of 7.8% quarter-on-quarter and 20% year-on-year delivering USD 487.6 million in Q2 FY27.
statements.target: FY27 revenue growth 20% YoY to USD 487.6M in Q2 FY27

statements.quote: EBIT margins for Q2 FY27 came in at 15%, 130 basis points declined year-on-year.
Sandeep Kalra: Yeah, so from our perspective we have said we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration.

We intend replacing the Euro 1.4 billion 18-month bridge loan with longer tenure, capital and favorable terms. As a part of this long-term financing strategy, we will be raising USD 1.25 billion in terms of both debt and equity.
statements.target: Raise USD 1.25B debt/equity, refinance 1.4B bridge loan

statements.quote: Over the next two quarters, we expect an incremental amount ranging between USD 25 to 30 million to be incurred towards the Nagarro transaction.
statements.target: Allocate USD 25-30M in next 2 quarters for Nagarro transaction costs

statements.quote: Our pipeline is healthy, we don't give forward looking guidance but we are relatively confident that all the segments will kind of grow very well.
statements.target: All business segments expected to grow in medium term

statements.quote: Total cash and investments stood at Rs. 29,996.7 million, around $315 million as of September 30, 2026 as against Rs. 27,044 million at the end of the previous quarter.
statements.target: Cash and investments increase to ~$315M by end of Q2 FY27
